title: Stop condition quality
failure_signature: model continues past the requested scope
model declares completion without checking stop conditions
model invents follow-on work as if authorized
prompt_delta: Stop when the bounded outputs are produced. State which stop condition was met. List follow-on ideas under suggested_next_steps without acting on them. Do not treat suggestions as authorized work.
validator_expectations: output must state which stop condition was met
suggested next steps must not be executed or claimed as done
